arguments.rule_content:
rule Packed_UPX_With_AntiVM {
    meta:
        description = "Detects UPX-packed binaries with common anti-VM artifacts"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.upx_pack"
        maxscore = 10
    strings:
        $upx1 = { 55 50 58 21 } // 'UPX!' header
        $anti_vm1 = "VMware" wide ascii
        $anti_vm2 = "VirtualBox" wide ascii
        $anti_vm3 = "HARDWARE\DESCRIPTION\System" wide ascii
        $dns_tunnel = "dns-tun" nocase
    condition:
        $upx1 and (2 of ($anti_vm*)) and $dns_tunnel
}

    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $x64_get_uri = "token" wide ascii
        $sleeptime = { 8b ?? 24 04 00 00 00 } // Common sleep time pattern
        $junk_data = { 00 00 00 00 } at entrypoint // Padding
    condition:
        $x64_get_uri and $sleeptime and #junk_data > 5
}
